Resolves #19947

The Portal's four example galleries now list the grid issues showcase (`examples/grid/issues`). The registries reach neomjs.com only inside the npm package, so this is a 13.3.0 cut blocker (Tobi, 2026-10-21).

- **Entries:** one per registry (`apps/portal/resources/data/examples_{devmode,dist_dev,dist_esm,dist_prod}.json`), id 29, named "GitHub Issues Grid". Each sits right after "Buffered Data Grid with 5M cells", next to the other grid demos, with its mode's URL. The Workstation still leads, and the choreography demo stays last.
- **Cover:** `apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/grid-issues-13-3.jpg`, 1280×720 like the 13.2 covers. It is the 13.3.0 notes' real dark-theme capture of the showcase, cropped to 16:9 from the top and scaled (SHA-256 `74346b39…f0cfb4e`). neomjs/pages#47 copies the same bytes to where the Portal serves covers from.

Evidence: L2 (registry spec over the four tracked files, red on `dev`, green here) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-3). The card on neomjs.com is the deployed read in #19652's Portal acceptance, after the 13.3.0 Pages deploy and neomjs/pages#47.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `TabContainerController.spec.mjs`, the new arm: each registry lists `examples/grid/issues` once, visible, with id 29 and its mode's URL, after the Workstation and before the choreography demo. The existing arms keep the Workstation first, the choreography demo last, and ids unique per file |
| AC-2 | The same arm asserts that the cover original exists at the entries' `image` path. The file is 1280×720 (`sips`) |
| AC-3 | On `dev` `33074574a8`, the new arm fails with "examples_devmode.json: the showcase is listed once", received length 0. With the change, the spec passes 6/6 |

## Deltas from ticket
- The existing id test pinned dist/prod's ids to exactly 1–28 and its keyed Store to 28 rows. It now pins 1–29 and 29: the ids stay contiguous, and every shipped row still survives the Store load.

## Test Evidence
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/` gives 6 passed. Before the registry edits, the new arm failed and the other 5 passed.
- All four registries parse as JSON. `check-ticket-archaeology` finds 0 violations.
- No build script or other test reads the registries (`git grep` over `test/` and `buildScripts/`).

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] After neomjs/pages#47 merges and the 13.3.0 Pages deploy runs, neomjs.com's gallery shows the "GitHub Issues Grid" card with its cover in all four modes and opens the showcase. That check is on #19652's Portal acceptance.
